identity.description: Supports source-aware biblical, theological, sermon, and teaching research without assigning beliefs to the user.

experience.promise: Reach a teachable, source-layered research brief without losing the distinction between text, tradition, prior writing, and synthesis.
experience.firstRunOutcome: An evidence-linked research brief that visibly separates biblical text, academic interpretation, tradition, prior user work, and AI synthesis.

successSignals.description: The user uses or refines a source-layered research brief for teaching or preaching.
The workflow helps the user recover relevant prior work without treating it as current belief.

capabilities.description: Read client-owned theological preferences and let only the client confirm their configuration without promoting inferred positions.
Research biblical, textual, academic, historical, and denominational sources in explicit layers.
Prepare sermon and teaching material, save client-authored research and explicitly approve assistant proposals.
Search and organize the client's private sermon and teaching archive, preserving prior revisions.

skills.outcome: A source-layered research brief whose synthesis never silently becomes the user's theological position.

providerRequirements.dataBoundary: Only operations verified as supported by an explicitly authorized optional Logos companion.

appRequirements.purpose: Optional Windows bridge for verified Logos Desktop operations only.

attentionTypes.description: A sermon or teaching commitment has an approaching due date.
